alias-of:place_1153>golgotha_487@695bce.note: 'the place of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha.'

alias-of:sea_of_tiberias_1034>sea_of_gal.note: 'the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.'

date:bread-of-life-sermon@2c186f.note: Passover is near (6:4) and the sermon follows the feeding (6:22-59). The AD year depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:chief-priests-conspire-against-jesu.note: The council (11:53) comes just before 'the Jews' passover was nigh' (11:55). The AD year depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:feast-of-dedication@2c186f.note: The feast is in winter (10:22); no year is given. The AD year depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:feast-of-tabernacles@2c186f.note: Tabernacles is at hand (7:2) and 'that great day of the feast' (7:37). The AD year depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:first-passover-and-temple-cleansing.note: The first Passover of Jesus' ministry (2:13, 2:23). The AD year depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:jesus-and-nicodemus@7a82e9.note: The night talk follows the Passover visit in Jerusalem (2:23). The AD year depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:jesus-withdraws-to-ephraim@22ede5.note: Withdrawal comes just before the Passover is near (11:54-55). The AD year depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:lazarus-raised-form-the-dead@22ede5.note: Bethany visit 'six days before the passover' (12:1); the raising came earlier. The AD year depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:light-of-the-world-i-am-discourse@2.note: Teaching continues after 'the last day, that great day of the feast' (7:37). The AD year depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:mary-anoints-jesus@22ede5.note: 'six days before the passover' (12:1). The AD year depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:the-good-shepherd-teaching@2c186f.note: 10:1-21 has no date; it precedes the winter Dedication (10:22). The AD year depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:upper-room-discourse@22ede5.note: 'before the feast of the passover' (13:1). The AD year depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:visiting-capernaum@7a82e9.note: Stay at Capernaum 'not many days' before the Passover (2:12-13). The AD year depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:water-to-wine@7a82e9.note: The wedding on 'the third day' comes just before the Passover (2:1, 2:13). The AD year depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:woman-caught-in-adultery@2c186f.note: Next morning after 'the last day' of the feast (7:37, 8:2). The AD year depends on dating outside Scripture.

occurred-at:bethesda-pool-healing>bethes.note: The pool at Jerusalem called Bethesda (5:2); the man lies by the pool when healed (5:7-9).

occurred-at:bread-of-life-sermon>caperna.note: 'These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.'

occurred-at:chief-priests-conspire-again.note: The council's room is not named. Jerusalem comes from the chief priests and 'the temple' (11:56), not a stated location.

occurred-at:feast-of-tabernacles>galilee.note: Jesus walked in Galilee before the feast (7:1), then went up and taught in the temple at Jerusalem (7:14, 7:25).

occurred-at:jesus-and-nicodemus>jerusale.note: Jesus was in Jerusalem at the Passover (2:23); the night visit (3:2) states no other place.

occurred-at:jesus-leaves-judea-toward-ga.note: 'He left Judaea, and departed again into Galilee.'

occurred-at:jesus-walks-on-water>sea_of_.note: 'the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias' (6:1); Jesus walks on the sea (6:19).

occurred-at:lazarus-raised-form-the-dead.note: Bethany lies near Jerusalem (11:18). Jesus stays outside the town at the tomb (11:30), so the tomb is near Bethany, not in it.

occurred-at:light-of-the-world-i-am-disc.note: Jesus teaches 'in the temple' (8:20); the feast crowd is 'of Jerusalem' (7:25). The verses name the temple, not the city.

occurred-at:the-good-shepherd-teaching>j.note: 10:1-21 names no place. Jerusalem comes from the next scene (10:22), so the setting is likely but open.

occurred-at:upper-room-discourse>jerusal.note: No place is named for the supper. Jerusalem is outside knowledge; 18:1 names only the brook Cedron.

occurred-at:woman-caught-in-adultery>jer.note: 'early in the morning he came again into the temple' (8:2). The temple is in Jerusalem but the city is not named.

parent-of:jonas_1687>andrew_264@da513f.note: Andrew is 'Simon Peter's brother' (1:40) and Jona is named as Peter's father (1:42). Andrew's father is never named.

part-of:bethesda_205>jerusalem_636@c59b1.note: 'at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, ... Bethesda.'

part-of:pavement_1155>jerusalem_636@7ca4.note: 19:20 says the crucifixion place was 'nigh to the city', not that the Pavement is in Jerusalem. Location is open.

participated-in:jesus_905>bethesda-pool-.note: Jesus speaks to the man (5:6) and tells him to rise and walk (5:8).

participated-in:jesus_905>bread-of-life-.note: Jesus says 'I am the bread of life' (6:35) and teaches it in the synagogue (6:59).

participated-in:jesus_905>feast-of-taber.note: 'he also up unto the feast' (7:10); 'Jesus went up into the temple, and taught' (7:14).

participated-in:jesus_905>lazarus-raised.note: Jesus cries, 'Lazarus, come forth' (11:43), and orders the grave-clothes loosed (11:44).

participated-in:jesus_905>mary-anoints-j.note: Mary anoints the feet of Jesus (12:3); Jesus answers her (12:7).

participated-in:jesus_905>visiting-caper.note: 'he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples.'

participated-in:jesus_905>water-to-wine@.note: Jesus tells the servants to fill the waterpots (2:7) and to draw out for the governor (2:8).

participated-in:jesus_905>woman-caught-i.note: Jesus says 'He that is without sin ... let him first cast a stone' (8:7) and speaks to the woman (8:11).

participated-in:lazarus_1812>lazarus-rai.note: Lazarus is the one raised: 'he that was dead came forth' (11:44).

participated-in:lazarus_1812>mary-anoint.note: Lazarus sits at the supper (12:2), but takes no act in the anointing (12:3-8).

participated-in:martha_1937>mary-anoints.note: Martha serves at the supper (12:2), but takes no act in the anointing (12:3-8).

participated-in:mary_1939>lazarus-raised.note: Mary falls at Jesus' feet and weeps (11:32-33) in the scene of the raising.

participated-in:nathanael_2158>first-dis.note: Nathanael speaks: 'Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth?' (1:46); 'Rabbi, thou art the Son of God' (1:49).

participated-in:nicodemus_2204>feast-of-.note: Nicodemus speaks in a Pharisee council (7:50) after the feast scene (7:37). The verses do not place it at the feast.

participated-in:peter_2745>bread-of-life.note: Peter answers only after the sermon, when disciples leave (6:66-68). He is not named within 6:22-59.

participated-in:peter_2745>first-discipl.note: Andrew brings 'his own brother Simon' (1:41); Jesus renames him Cephas (1:42).

participated-in:john_1677>first-disciple.note: The second disciple of 1:35-40 is never named; John the Apostle is an identification from outside the text.

participated-in:thomas_2851>resurrection.note: Thomas states his condition (20:25) and confesses 'My Lord and my God' (20:28).

visited:caiaphas_532>jerusalem_636@6cbc9.note: Caiaphas is high priest at the hearing (18:13) and Jesus is led from his house (18:28). Jerusalem is not named there.
